dashboardCommon.menuTemplateDescPhotoSpotlight: One enormous photo fills the screen; a floating glass card holds the details and add button.
dashboardCommon.menuTemplateDescArchCrop: Photos crowned with an arch — soft, boutique-bakery style with curved tops.
dashboardCommon.menuTemplateDescPeekCarousel: Full-height cards you swipe sideways; the next card peeks at the right edge.
dashboardCommon.menuTemplateDescFullBleedReel: Each dish fills the entire screen; swipe up to the next like a video reel.
dashboardCommon.menuTemplateDescFilmStrip: Dishes run as film frames between retro sprocket rails — personality-forward.
dashboardCommon.menuTemplateDescMagazineCover: An editorial masthead in Playfair Display, issue number, and full-bleed hero photo.
dashboardCommon.menuTemplateDescGalleryPrint: One dish displayed as a framed gallery print with an offset gold mat.
dashboardCommon.menuTemplateDescOrganicCircles: Round photo bubbles in a 2-column grid — playful, perfect for a gelato or bakery shop.
dashboardCommon.menuTemplateDescHexagonHoneycomb: Photos clipped into hexagons — geometric and fresh for a health-food or bowl concept.
dashboardCommon.menuTemplateDescSpotlightStage: One dish takes centre stage in a large hero frame, with the rest in a scrollable ticker rail below.
dashboardCommon.menuTemplateDescFramedGallery: Every dish hung like art — matted, framed, with a museum caption plaque. Ideal for a patisserie or fine bakery.
dashboardCommon.menuTemplateDescPosterWall: Every item is a concert poster — full-bleed photo, bold type, price badge in the corner. Built for a bar or live venue.
dashboardCommon.menuTemplateDescDoublePageSpread: Editorial broadsheet layout: first item gets a full spread, the rest scroll as typographic articles. Sophisticated bistro feel.
dashboardCommon.menuTemplateDescCurvedHero: A full-width photo with a convex arc at the bottom bleeds into the content list. Fresh, airy garden café look.
dashboardCommon.menuTemplateDescCoverflow3D: iTunes-era coverflow: center card faces forward while flanking cards rotate in perspective. Perfect for a cocktail bar.
dashboardCommon.menuTemplateDescFullBleedSwipe: Each item fills the entire screen — swipe horizontally to browse. Dot pager and a bold Add CTA at the bottom.
dashboardCommon.menuTemplateDescFeaturedGrid: The first item per category gets a full-width hero feature. The rest fill a compact 2-column grid below it.
dashboardCommon.menuTemplateDescStoryChapters: Every category is a chapter with a Playfair Display title page and items as typographic 'pages'. Great for a bookstore café.
dashboardCommon.menuTemplateDescDuotoneSpotlight: Photos converted to bold duotone color with a vivid tint overlay. A graphic, gallery-like grid for a modern tapas bar.
dashboardCommon.menuTemplateDescRadialFan: Categories as petal-shaped chips fanned in a semicircular arc. Tap a petal to switch, items shown as warm stacked cards.
dashboardCommon.menuTemplateDescBlobMask: Item photos clipped into organic blob shapes that alternate across a 2-col grid. Playful, organic feel for a health or smoothie bar.
dashboardCommon.menuTemplateDescHorizontalFilmstrip: Each category is a horizontal filmstrip shelf with sprocket-hole edges. Scroll each strip independently, cinema-themed aesthetic.
dashboardCommon.menuTemplateDescDiagonalMosaic: 3-column grid with the middle column staggered down for an interlocking diagonal mosaic. Photos have a diagonal cut at the bottom edge.
dashboardCommon.menuTemplateDescStickyHeroSheet: A full-bleed hero photo stays fixed while an iOS-style rounded bottom sheet slides up with the menu items inside.
dashboardCommon.menuTemplateDescTopArcDial: Category chips arranged on a concave arc across the top of the screen. Tap any chip to dial in that category below.
dashboardCommon.menuTemplateDescBentoDeluxe: Evolved bento grid alternating full-width heroes, 2-col pairs, and 3-col trios. Clean editorial type with Playfair Display names.
